title: Frontiers: Which Firms Gain from Digital Advertising? Evidence from a Field Experiment
authors: Weijia Dai; Hyunjin Kim; Michael Luca
eligible_reason: Randomized Yelp advertising experiment: all treated restaurants receive ads at the same time (Aug-Oct 2015, post; Nov-Dec, post2). One adoption date, so no staggered design. Regressions are restaurant FE + month FE with treated x post and treated x post2 (two-period treatment indicators), plus status- and chain-category interactions.
design_notes: table_1-4.do: xtreg outcome treatXpost treatXpost2 i.month, fe robust by restaurant status (Table 1), pooled with reweighted status interactions (Tables 2-4: postXtr_w, postXtrXst*_w, postXst*), category heterogeneity (chain, rating, traffic, reviews). fig_2.do: month x treated event study with common onset. table1_pct_effect_bootstrap.do: bootstrap CIs for percent effects.
data_files_note: README: random 20% sample of restaurants (3,658 of 18,294); outcomes divided by full-sample pre-experiment SD (Yelp data agreement).
data_provenance_note: Random 20% subsample with linearly rescaled outcomes (authors_transformed).
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not staggered (single experimental onset).
